# BrownHub

## Overview
BrownHub is a graphic design and website company in Accra, Ghana, helping businesses, brands, entrepreneurs and individuals communicate their ideas through compelling visual design — and building the websites, online catalogs, booking tools and web apps that carry it.

## Services
- Logo Design
- Brand Identity Design
- Social Media Design
- Flyer & Poster Design
- Business Card Design
- Brochure & Company Profile Design
- Packaging Design
- Marketing & Advertising Graphics
- Custom Graphic Design
- Website design and development: https://www.brownhub283.com/websites.html
- Website and software engineering (web apps, client accounts, payments, dashboards, hosting): https://www.brownhub283.com/engineering.html

## What we do
Logos, brand identity systems, print and packaging — designed to make brands stand out, with website design, development and software as the second half of the studio.
